title: feat(spec)!: a URL is judged as a URL parser cleans it — surrounding whitespace trimmed, tab and newline characters removed — with one userinfo grammar at both doors; a credential query parameter is refused in any string of a connector entry
body:
security#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no connector entry that `skills/**`, the hand-written `content/docs/**`, `examples/**` or `packages/apps/**` author holds a credential query parameter in any string under `providerConfig` or `auth`, and none of their datasource or connector URLs carries a credential part (scanned: 0 connector or datasource literals affected; the shipped OpenAPI documents those apps reference by path: 0), so nothing they teach changes; each refusal carries its own prescription.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：连接器实例与数据源驱动配置里的值按 URL 解析器的读法判定：先去掉首尾的 C0 控制字符与空格，并删除值中任意位置的制表符、换行符与回车符，再判定——userinfo 与查询参数两半、连接器与数据源两扇门都如此；连接器的 userinfo 改用数据源已有的同一套语法（权限部分以 `scheme://` 或无 scheme 的 `//` 起始）；连接器条目 `providerConfig` 与 `auth` 下任意字符串里带值的凭据类查询参数一律拒绝。保存门 422 `INVALID_METADATA`，定位到该字符串；两侧读取在写入判定的原始位置改写，其余字符原样返回。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决 D：两扇门一条值级规则，目的是让检查看到的就是使用方解析器看到的。删除制表/换行字符与连接器沿用数据源的 scheme 可选语法，正是这同一条规则；二者超出裁决的字面文本，席位已作为否决窗口呈报维护者（经契约复核档审核为既裁执行）。
- 风险与回滚：破坏性收窄（spec minor，一条 ADR-0087 D3 条目 `url-credential-judged-trimmed-and-in-any-connector-string`）。升级后在校验、构建产物加载与保存时被拒的有：连接器 `providerConfig`/`auth` 的任意字符串里带值的凭据查询参数；按解析器清洗后（去首尾空白、删除制表/换行字符）含凭据部分的 URL；连接器中无 scheme 的 `//` 权限部分所带的 userinfo。仓内 examples/apps/skills/docs 实测 0 处受影响。已存行不重判；读取隐去凭据部分，原样保存保留库值。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/driver/url-boundary.ts`（唯一的边界解析：按解析器清洗并保留到原始串的偏移映射，userinfo 区间供两扇门共用）、`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-url-credentials.ts`（`connectorUrlWithoutUserinfo` 同时供写判与读改写；查询参数判定作用于任意字符串）、`packages/spec/src/data/datasource-credential-redaction.ts`（`redactUrlPassword` 按写入侧同一区间改写）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/integration/connector-entry-url-credentials.test.ts src/data/datasource-credential-redaction.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One value-level rule at both doors — **a URL is judged after trimming surrounding whitespace; a credential query parameter is refused in any string of the entry.**

- **Cleaned as a URL parser cleans it.** A value is judged after trimming its leading and trailing C0 control characters and spaces and removing every tab, newline and carriage return in it — both halves, both doors. Each query pair is cleaned before its name is read. The userinfo is read on the cleaned string and rewritten at the matching offsets of the authored string.
- **One userinfo grammar at both doors.** The connector entry locates a userinfo with `urlUserinfoSpan`, the scheme-optional grammar the datasource doors already use: an authority starts at `scheme://` or a scheme-relative `//`.
- **Any string.** The connector entry's credential query parameter rule runs the single value-level parse the datasource doors already run (`urlCredentialQueryParams`) on every string under `providerConfig` and `auth`, scheme or none. Same names, same located refusal, never echoing the value.
- **The read rewrites exactly what the write refuses.** `packages/spec/src/data/driver/url-boundary.ts` (internal, not re-exported) holds the one boundary parse: `urlTrimmedBounds` and `urlUserinfoSpan`, offsets into the authored string. The datasource write accessors (`urlUserinfoPassword`, `urlUserinfoUsername`) read the userinfo there and the datasource read (`redactUrlPassword`) rewrites the password there. On the connector side `connectorUrlWithoutUserinfo` is both the write door's userinfo judgement (does it change the value?) and the read's rewrite, and the query pairs go through the shared `credentialQueryParamOf`. Every other character, the surrounding ones included, is served as stored. At this head the boundary parse is `urlAsParsed` (the cleaned string with a map back to raw offsets) and `urlUserinfoSpan` (raw offsets, the cleaned userinfo, the mapped colon); `connectorUrlWithoutUserinfo` removes the whole userinfo and its `@` at those offsets.
- **Unchanged.** No rule keyed on a provider key name; `ConnectorSchema` keeps its posture; header and environment maps are judged by neither door; stored rows are never re-judged, a save of the served form keeps the stored value, and an edit stores the edit. No public export added or removed (`check:api-surface` unchanged).
- ADR-0087 D3 entry `18.url-credential-judged-trimmed-and-in-any-connector-string.ts`; changeset `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING, with its FROM → TO and the registration marker.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-entry-url-credentials.test.ts` — new block: refused at the string (userinfo behind surrounding whitespace, `api_key`/`client_secret` in a URL behind whitespace, `token` and the instance's `paramName` in a string with no scheme, `signature` in a string that is not a URL, an `auth.tokenUrl` behind whitespace); CONTROL accepts (clean URLs with surrounding whitespace, scheme-less and non-URL strings holding none, empty credential values); the read rewrites the same position with surrounding bytes kept and the served form passes the write door; refused ⇔ rewritten over `providerConfig.baseUrl`, a non-URL `providerConfig` string and `auth.tokenUrl`.
- `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.test.ts` — the pin that held a non-URL string with a credential parameter untouched pinned the removed boundary; it is split into a still-untouched CONTROL (a non-URL string holding none) and the new rewrite pin.
- `packages/spec/src/data/driver/driver-credential-refusal.test.ts` — per URL-bearing driver key (postgres, mysql, mongo, turso `url`, turso `syncUrl`): `user:password@` refused behind each of five surroundings, and a bare username behind each not refused for a password; `urlUserinfoPassword` judges the trimmed string.
- `packages/spec/src/data/datasource-credential-redaction.test.ts` — the datasource read rewrites the password at the position the write door judges, keeps the username and every surrounding character, and the served form passes the write door; CONTROL strings come back byte for byte; `redactDatasourceConfig` names `url`.
- Dogfood, both HTTP save doors: `connector-meta-door-url-and-nested-keys.dogfood.test.ts` gains a block on the existing showcase boot (five 422 refusals at `PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name` with nothing stored; a credential-free URL with surrounding whitespace saves, materializes `ready` and dispatches; a seeded row is served with the parts removed at the judged position to a member and an administrator; a save of the served form keeps the stored values). New `datasource-meta-door-url-credential-trimmed.dogfood.test.ts` (three 422 refusals at `PUT /api/v1/meta/datasource/:name` with nothing stored; a bare username and a clean URL save as written; a seeded row is served with the password removed and its surrounding characters kept; the stored row untouched).
- Test names state the rule. Every placeholder is fake and every assertion on one is its absence from what a door served.

- `connector-entry-url-credentials.test.ts` — a second block: refused at the string for a credential name holding a tab or newline (URL and non-URL string), a userinfo behind a scheme or `//` holding a tab or carriage return, a scheme-relative userinfo; CONTROL accepts for an ordinary name holding a tab, a credential value of only tab/newline characters, a cleaned scheme with no userinfo, a scheme-relative authority with no userinfo, an `@` in a scheme-relative path; the read rewrites at the matching authored offsets; refused ⇔ rewritten.
- `driver-credential-refusal.test.ts` — per URL-bearing driver key: `user:password@` refused with a tab, newline or carriage return inside the scheme or the password; CONTROL a bare username and a password of only that character; per query driver: the parameter refused with such a character inside its name, CONTROL a value of only such characters; the shared parses read pairs and userinfo with them deleted.
- `datasource-credential-redaction.test.ts` — the read removes the password at the mapped offsets and a credential pair whose name holds such a character, keeping the rest of the query; CONTROL strings unchanged.
- Dogfood, both save doors: connector — 422 for a credential name holding a tab, a scheme holding a tab, a scheme-relative userinfo; CONTROL an ordinary name holding a tab saves, materializes and is sent as the parser reads it, a scheme-relative URL with no userinfo saves. Datasource postgres — 422 for a `password` name holding a tab and a scheme holding a tab; CONTROL a bare username and an ordinary name each with a tab save as written; a seeded row is served with its credential parts removed at the judged positions.

## Acceptance notes

- **Basis for the two additions beyond the ruled text.** The maintainer's ruling D is "one value-level rule at both doors"; its stated purpose is that the check sees what the consuming parser sees. Removing tab/newline characters before judging, and the connector using the datasource's scheme-optional userinfo grammar, are that same rule. They narrow beyond the ruled literal text, and the seat has put that to the maintainer as a veto window.
- **Consumers.** The cleaning matches the WHATWG parse that pg-connection-string, mysql2 and the mongodb driver apply to these values; for `@libsql/core`, which applies none, it only refuses at publish a value the client rejects at connect.

- **Cost measured.** A non-URL string under `providerConfig` holding a credential parameter with a value is now refused. Over `examples/`, `packages/apps/`, `skills/`, `content/docs/` and `apps/docs/` (`git grep` for a credential name after `?` or `&` with a value): 3 hits, none in a connector entry (a storage-service doc comment and two auth-docs `fetch` calls); the three OpenAPI documents `packages/apps` and the showcase reference by path: 0 hits.
- `auth` endpoints are URLs by their own declared format, so a string with no scheme there is already refused by that format; the any-string rule matters under `providerConfig`.
- The other package this diff touches is `packages/qa/dogfood` (private, tests only).
